facts.fact: The Internet Society's IXP Tracker, from PeeringDB data of August 2026, lists BDIXP in Bujumbura with 9 member ASNs, 26 Gbps of cumulative port capacity and no members joining or leaving in the previous 12 months.

The Internet Society's IXP Tracker lists Akamai Technologies (AS20940, 1 Gbps, peers at the route server) and Meta (AS63293, 10 Gbps) as members of BDIXP in Bujumbura, from PeeringDB data of August 2026.

The Internet Society's IXP Tracker shows BDIXP members registered abroad (3 in the United States, including Meta and two PCH ASNs, and 1 in the Netherlands, Akamai) beside 5 registered in Burundi, from PeeringDB data of August 2026.

systems.owner: Republic of Burundi; managed by an ISP association authorised by ARCT

note: The 2014 decree creates BDIXP and sets its rules but states no networks exchanging traffic there, so it is an instrument, not evidence of service.
Starlink article names exchanges only for Johannesburg, Nairobi and Lagos gateways; nothing on an exchange in Burundi.

facts.fact: The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Burundi: BDIXP, Bujumbura.
Internet Society's report counts one IXP in Burundi, with 55.56% of local networks connected to it.
Internet Society Pulse says Burundi's reported IXP count, memberships and coverage all rose between March 2019 and March 2026.
